source_instruction: i am looking for light blonde hair extensions that are 18 inches long.
query:
I swear the weirdest thing happened to me on my walk over to the store today! I cut through the little community park like I always do, and there was a group of tiny kids clustered around the base of the big old oak tree by the playground, all oohing and ahhing so loud I had to stop and see what was up. Turns out they’d found a baby squirrel that’d tumbled out of its nest, all fuzzy and wobbly, and none of them dared touch it even though they were all dying to make sure it was okay. I ended up hanging out for ten minutes helping them corral it into a shoeboxox one of the kids ran home to grab, and waited with them until a local wildlife rehab volunteer showed up to take it in and make sure it didn’t have any injuries. It was such a sweet, random little detour that totally made my whole morning feel brighter, honestly.
Hey, I’m browsing the hair loss products section right now looking for hair extensions, can you help me out? I need them to be 18 inch long, and I want that one shade I always get, you know the one I’m talking about right? Also make sure they come with a free satin storage pouch to keep them from getting tangled when I’m not wearing them, that’s a must-have for me. Let me know what options you’ve got that fit, yeah?
